newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar rises to 32-month high of 1.6565 marks.
newsitem.headline: Dollar rises to 32-month high of 1.6565 marks.

text.p: The dollar powered its way above 1.6565 marks in Tokyo on Friday, a fresh 32-month high, after rising in overnight trade on a massive increase in German unemployment figures, dealers said.

The numbers, released Thursday, showed that unemployment surged by more than half a million to a post-war record of 4.66 million in January, a level last seen in the depths of the Great Depression of the 1930s.
